description: 서울특별시 공공자전거 실시간 대여정보 [cycling networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 서울특별시. 서울시 자전거 관련 정보를 제공합니다. Coverage: 서울특별시. The portal files it under the publisher 서울특별시. Its tags are 공기주입기, 자전거대여소, 자전거도로, 교통물류. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2019-09-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
